facts.fact: Biometric Update states that the Learner's Identification Number, a unique 16-digit number assigned to each student and associated with demographic and educational data, began rolling out in April 2026 with 1.9 million IDs issued.

Biometric Update reports, from an announcement on X, that the Ministry of Education and NIMC integrated the Learner's Identification Number of 80 million students with the national identity number registry through the digital NEMIS; the announcement is undated, so the document's published date is used.

Biometric Update names Nigeria's Ministry of Education as the body that, with NIMC, integrated the learner numbers held through its digital NEMIS; no date is given for ownership, so the document's published date is used.

systems.tiers: registers students through the education system; 1.9 million IDs at the April 2026 start
